name: Gigantes
source_text: This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 1 EARTH monster in your Graveyard from play. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.
notes: The summoning condition is rules text; the script covers the destruction trigger.
